scope: Complete and repair TMS conversation reopening, native invitation set semantics and protocol-safe rosters. This is not certification of official whole-game parity.

history_review.finding: Initial TMS handlers used a list for targets and did not correlate reconnect answers or bind their source map.
Preserve the corrected per-recipient roster/key/inviter and logout notifications, protected-invite checks, friend/group fixes and localized NoReceiver text. Five focused preservation checks pass.

references.rule: Reopen a one-member conversation by asking the last peer main map, check invite blocking there, then announce the roster and replay the original message. Invitation target IDs form a set before 1:1 merge selection.
Return the sender/target routes, protected-invite result, conversation ID and original message.

implemented: Distinct ordered invitation targets preserve native set semantics and allow duplicate IDs to reopen the same conversation.

World accepts each reopening answer only against a pending server-owned message and the current target main/key/object. Unsolicited, stale, changed-text, wrong-map and repeated answers do not grant membership. Multiple real messages with identical text remain distinct pending actions.

Absent main routes return the localized NoReceiver net string; disconnecting a prompted peer also notifies the waiting sender even when that peer has no TMS memberships yet. Leaving/logging out clears pending requests.
Current membership, sender main/key, and faction eligibility are rechecked. Map loading/secondary sessions cannot send, invite, leave or approve a reopening.

Roster limits follow the existing one-byte wire count: 255 is accepted; larger new or expanded rosters are refused before mutation. This is a protocol integrity bound, not a new gameplay balance rule.

validation.platform: Isolated Linux .NET 10 SDK; source read-only. Database smoke tests are gated without live connection settings.

test_fixture_update: SocialAuditTests now sends TMSSEND and receives the invite-check request before its ACK. All prior roster assertions remain; the old fixture injected an unsolicited ACK directly.
remaining: Real-client conversation leave/reopen, blocking, relog and multi-map handoff need verification.

Sender/target answer correlation, disconnect failure notification, current-state checks and one-byte roster bound are integrity corrections to the inherited implementation; they do not establish official Gameforge parity.
Existing ordinary chat, separate BoW/BR match-server gaps and locale verification remain as recorded in Gameforge/chat-routing.json.

current_deployment.note: Earlier implementation/validation notes retain their historical scope. Current cumulative source is deployed; deployment does not certify whole-game or full gameplay restart parity.
